title: Atrocities in the Congo Free State
place: Congo Free State (present-day Democratic Republic of the Congo)
summary: King Leopold II's privately owned state forced Congolese people to meet rubber quotas, enforced by the Force Publique with killings, hostage-taking and severed hands. Estimates of population loss range from about 1.2-1.5 million to 10 million.
why: Forced labour, terror and disease cut populations sharply; the size of the toll and the genocide label remain heatedly debated.

notes.problem: Source's 1.2 or 1.5 million is a population decrease from demographic research (causes 'multifactorial'), not a death toll; label it population loss.
